relation_to_lost_execution: New execution; unrecovered choices fixed explicitly, historical scores never used as new results

dataset.selection: Uniform deterministic sampling of sorted image IDs, official train for training, disjoint subsets of official dev for calibration/validation, official test for test; all annotations on selected images retained
dataset.source_captions: Five original Flickr30k captions per image
dataset.superseded_source: Deprecated virginie-do/e-SNLI-VE release rejected after source-only overlap audit, before training or held-out scoring

encoder.text_optimization: Discard only causal positions after batch-last EOT; require normalized-feature parity within 2e-6 against stock; record exact parity checks

adapter.type: independent zero-initialized bias-free linear residual image/text maps plus L2 normalization

training.candidate_texts: All source captions and all annotated hypotheses belonging to images in the batch
training.known_unrecovered_choices: Learning rate grid, batch size, optimizer details and semantic kernel are explicit reconstruction choices

objectives.uniform_positive_loss: log weighted normalizer minus mean positive score; symmetric image/text mean, skip text anchors with no positive
objectives.source_positive_set: source captions only, including for similarity/smoothing controls
objectives.random_exclusion: Start expanded; randomly omit same number of eligible nonpositive candidates per image row as labeled neutrals; transpose same mask
objectives.pairwise_ranking: mean softplus(contradicted score - supported score) over Cartesian pairs within each eligible image, then average images
objectives.semantic_similarity: Mean (1+cosine)/2 between each candidate text and the frozen source-caption features for its image anchor
objectives.semantic_weight: sigmoid((threshold-similarity)/0.05); positive weights forced to one; all semantic weights detached
objectives.median_threshold: Median semantic similarity over all nonpositive cells in the batch
objectives.shuffle: Globally permute nonpositive fixed-threshold weights, preserving their batch distribution
objectives.reverse_weights: Transpose the identical image-text weight matrix

selection.score: Mean of validation image-to-text R@1 and image-averaged supported-versus-contradicted hypothesis accuracy
selection.retrieval_relevance: Source plus supported captions are correct; every validation caption/hypothesis is in the candidate pool
selection.best_epoch: Per seed, maximize score, earliest epoch wins ties
selection.learning_rate: Per method, maximize mean best validation score across all three seeds, lower rate wins ties
selection.test_usage: None before all 108 candidates and 36 selections are frozen

evaluation.esnli: Image-averaged supported-vs-contradicted Cartesian-pair ranking on 400 test images; half-credit ties; report eligible-image denominator
evaluation.sugarcrepe: All 7511 official pairs, strict original-positive score greater than foil
evaluation.sugarcrepe_pp: All 4757 official triplets, both official positive captions strictly outrank official foil; preserve source strings independently of SugarCrepe
evaluation.coco: Full Karpathy test 5000 images with first five captions per image in source order, both retrieval directions R@1/5/10 and mean/median ranks
evaluation.frozen_reference: Same final float32 normalization as zero-initialized adapter; score accumulation float64
evaluation.overlaps: Audit exact image overlaps across all pools; shared COCO-derived pools are complementary measurements, not independent replications

statistics.unit: Image clusters, paired across methods, selected-seed scores averaged within each sampled image; use appropriate image/pair weighting per endpoint
statistics.training_seed_uncertainty: Report individual seeds and sample standard deviation; image bootstrap conditions on selected runs
statistics.secondary: All retrieval, valid-alternative, exclusion/weight controls and edit-category grouping are descriptive; no new significance labels

relation_diagnostic.role: Separate appendix diagnostic, never supplies primary adapter labels
relation_diagnostic.crossfit: Three image-disjoint folds for training predictions
relation_diagnostic.calibration: Image-disjoint half for temperature NLL, half for threshold choice; seed0
relation_diagnostic.selective_rule: For support and contradiction separately, choose maximum coverage among thresholds with at least20 accepted pairs and Wilson95% precision lower bound at least0.90
relation_diagnostic.test: MacroF1, accuracy, ECE10bins, Brier, NLL, class-specific selective precision/coverage; descriptive image bootstrap
